name: Tibbit
traits: Small Monstrous Humanoid with the Shapechanger subtype, as corrected by Paizo’s errata. +2 Dexterity, −2 Strength, 20-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., and +2 racial to Spot, Jump, and Escape Artist.

Small size gives +1 AC and attack, +4 Hide, Small weapon sizes, and three quarters of Medium carrying capacity. Humanoid-only spells such as charm person do not affect Tibbits. Class levels supply their Hit Dice, with no added level adjustment.

Feline Transformation lets a Tibbit become a house cat at will as a standard action. The rules give no duration limit. Returning to humanoid form takes a full-round action. Wait one hour after returning before transforming again.

Cat form is Tiny and has 30-ft. land speed, +2 size AC and attack, +8 size Hide, −8 Strength to a minimum of 3, and +2 Dexterity on top of humanoid-form scores. It gains scent and keeps its creature type and otherwise unchanged abilities.
Cat form gains two primary claws (1d2 base damage) and a secondary bite (1d3 base damage). A full attack uses both claws and the bite at −5. Base attack bonus gives no additional natural attacks.

Equipment generally melds into the cat. Armor, shields, weapons, and robes stop providing benefits. Items with a suitable worn shape may continue giving passive benefits when they reshape into something a cat can wear.
Cat form cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast spells with verbal or somatic components, use scrolls, or activate magic items.
Death in cat form causes reversion after one round. Effects that see through polymorph reveal the Tibbit. Magic aura detection alone does not reveal the disguise.

Common and Feline are automatic, with any bonus language and Rogue as the favored class. Feline is shared with cats of Intelligence 3 or higher, permitting Diplomacy with them. Other races cannot learn it or bridge it with tongues.
